I found 10 codes that indicate a person has hidradenitis suppurativa (HS).

**Included codes**

| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis (in Read v2, this parent code is used for HS) |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| EGTON66 | Hydradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCTSU346454 | Suppurative hidradenitis |
| ^ESCTHI346451 | Hidradenitis axillaris |
| ^ESCTAX667047 | Axillary hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCTAN667048 | Anogenital hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCTVU667049 | Vulval hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCT1501708 | Hidradenitis suppurativa of multiple sites |
| ^ESCTFO669402 | Follicular occlusion triad - hidradenitis, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of scalp |

**Judgement calls**
- **M25y1 Hidradenitis:** this generic term is included because it's the parent code of M25y1-1. If you want only codes that name HS directly, leave it out.
- **Follicular occlusion triad:** included because HS is part of this combined condition. Leave it out if you want a narrower list.

**Excluded codes**
- **^ESCTNE512593 Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis:** a different condition.
- **^ESCTRE667046 Retro-auricular cysts (hidradenitis):** the code doesn't make clear whether this means HS. Check it if you want the widest possible list.
- **Hidradenoma, hidradenocarcinoma and hidrocystoma codes:** sweat gland tumours and cysts, not HS.
- **Look-alike conditions:** pilonidal disease, acne conglobata on its own, dissecting cellulitis on its own (folliculitis/perifolliculitis abscedens et suffodiens), boils and furunculosis, Fox-Fordyce disease, and other sweat gland disorders.
- **Procedure codes:** excision of sweat-gland-bearing skin is a common HS operation, but it can be done for other reasons, so it isn't a reliable diagnosis code.

**Codes included**

|---|---|

| ^ESCTFO669402 | Follicular occlusion triad – hidradenitis, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of scalp ³ |

¹ This is the general "hidradenitis" heading, and hidradenitis suppurativa sits directly under it. I kept it because it is the parent code, but it isn't specific to the condition.
² Borderline. I included it because the term names hidradenitis, but I couldn't confirm from the store whether it is classed as hidradenitis suppurativa. Leave it out if you want a tighter list.

- **Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis (^ESCTNE512593):** a different disease of the sweat glands.

- **Pilonidal disease, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of the scalp, and boils or abscesses in the armpit or groin:** related or look-alike conditions, but none means the person has hidradenitis suppurativa.
- **Excision of sweat gland-bearing skin (procedures):** a procedure is not a diagnosis.

content.text:
I found 11 codes in the knowledge store that indicate a person has hidradenitis suppurativa (HS).

**Core codes (Read)**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |

**Local code**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| EGTON66 | Hydradenitis suppurativa |

**SNOMED-mapped (^ESCT) codes**
| Code | Description |
|---|---|
| ^ESCTSU346454 | Suppurative hidradenitis |
| ^ESCTHI346451 | Hidradenitis axillaris |
| ^ESCTAX667047 | Axillary hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCTAN667048 | Anogenital hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCTVU667049 | Vulval hidradenitis suppurativa |
| ^ESCT1501708 | Hidradenitis suppurativa of multiple sites |
| ^ESCTRE667046 | Retro-auricular cysts (hidradenitis) |
| ^ESCTFO669402 | Follicular occlusion triad - hidradenitis, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of scalp |

**Judgement calls you may want to change**
- **M25y1 "Hidradenitis":** I included it because in Read it is the parent of the HS code and is used for HS in practice. It doesn't say "suppurativa," though.
- **Retro-auricular cysts (hidradenitis):** I included it because the label ties it to hidradenitis. I couldn't confirm from the store that it is formally classed as a type of HS, so remove it if you want a strict list.
- **Follicular occlusion triad:** I included it because HS is one of its three parts by definition. Remove it if you only want codes that name HS alone.

**Left out on purpose**
- **Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis:** a different disease.
